raw.details:
SUSTAINIQ 2026 – Mine Ideas, Craft the Future!

Overview

Innovate. Build. Sustain.

SUSTAINIQ 2026 is a National-Level, 24-Hour Multidisciplinary Sustainability Hackathon organized by the Department of Civil Engineering in collaboration with the Innovators & Visionaries Club (IVC) and InUnity Pvt Ltd, at Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering (VVCE), Mysuru.

Inspired by the creativity of Minecraft, SUSTAINIQ brings together student innovators, developers, engineers, designers, and problem-solvers from across India to transform real-world sustainability challenges into impactful technological solutions.

Important Registration & Payment Information

Initial registration and preliminary PPT submission are completely FREE. No payment is required at this stage.

Only teams shortlisted after the preliminary PPT evaluation will be required to pay a participation fee of ₹999 per team to confirm their participation in the final 24-hour offline hackathon.

  • Preliminary PPT Submission Deadline: 27 November 2026, 8:00 PM IST.

  • Shortlisting Results: 28 November 2026.

  • Participation Fee: ₹999 per shortlisted team.

  • Payment Window: 28 November 2026, 5:00 PM to 30 November 2026, 12:00 PM IST.

  • Payment instructions will be communicated directly to shortlisted teams through their registered email addresses.

  • Payments will be collected externally by the organizers.

  • Teams that are not shortlisted are not required to make any payment.

Waitlisted Teams

If shortlisted teams fail to confirm their participation within the specified payment deadline, the vacant slots will be offered to waitlisted teams from the respective domains.

  • Waitlist Confirmation Window: 30 November 2026, 2:00 PM to 1 December 2026, 5:00 AM IST.

  • Waitlisted teams will be notified through their registered email addresses.

  • Selection will depend on domain-wise slot availability.

  • A maximum of 20 teams per domain will be permitted.

Domains

The hackathon features four major domains, each containing 10 official problem statements:

  1. AI, Data Science & Digital Innovation

  2. IoT, Embedded Systems & Smart Technologies

  3. Clean Energy & Sustainable Engineering

  4. Smart Infrastructure & Environmental Sustainability

Official Problem Statement Release & Selection – Eventra Platform

All official problem statements and their selection will be managed through Eventra, the event management platform for SUSTAINIQ 2026.

Eventra Website: https://eventra-ivc.vercel.app/

Problem Statement Release

  • Date: 1 December 2026

  • Time: 8:00 AM IST

  • Official problem statements will be released across the four domains.

  • Teams can review the available problem statements before the selection process begins.

Problem Statement Selection

  • Selection Opens: 1 December 2026, 8:00 PM IST.

  • Selection Closes: 2 December 2026, 9:00 PM IST.

  • Only shortlisted teams that have successfully completed their participation fee payment will be eligible.

  • Login credentials for Eventra will be sent to the registered email addresses of confirmed teams.

  • Teams must select one problem statement from their registered domain.

  • Selection will follow a first-come, first-served basis.

  • Each problem statement can be selected by a maximum of two teams.

Automatic Problem Statement Allocation

Teams that have completed their participation fee payment but fail to select a problem statement within the specified selection period will automatically be assigned an available problem statement from their registered domain through Eventra.

The assigned problem statement will be updated on the team's Eventra dashboard.

Teams are encouraged to select their preferred problem statement before the deadline.

Hackathon Structure

The final event is a continuous 24-hour development experience featuring:

  • On-site registration and inauguration.

  • Development of innovative solutions for assigned problem statements.

  • Technical mentoring and guidance.

  • Intermediate project evaluations.

  • Final judging and project demonstrations.

  • Results announcement and valedictory ceremony.

All mentoring and judging checkpoints are mandatory.

AI tools, APIs, open-source libraries, and pre-trained models are permitted with proper disclosure.

Prizes & Recognition

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹60,000.

  • First Prize: ₹7,000 per domain.

  • Second Prize: ₹5,000 per domain.

  • Third Prize: ₹3,000 per domain.

  • Participation certificates and event goodies will be provided.

  • Additional rewards and sponsorship benefits may be announced.

Food & Refreshments

Participants will be provided with:

DAY 1

  • Morning snacks

  • Lunch

  • Evening snacks

  • Dinner

DAY 2

  • Midnight snacks

  • Breakfast

Accommodation will not be provided.

Event Details

  • Dates: 3–4 December 2026

  • Duration: 24 Hours

  • Venue: Sports Complex, Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering, Mysuru, Karnataka.

  • Organized by: Department of Civil Engineering, VVCE.

  • In Collaboration With: Innovators & Visionaries Club (IVC) and InUnity Pvt Ltd.

Official WhatsApp Group – Stay Connected!

Join the official SUSTAINIQ 2026 WhatsApp group to receive important announcements, shortlisting updates, payment instructions, Eventra login credentials and guidance, problem statement releases, and event updates.

Join our official WhatsApp group here:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/KGVSA105R4TECBTbmvptF8

Contact Information

Moksh – Marketing Lead: +91 83103 53103

Parinitha – Secretary: +91 63614 55193

Email: ivcoffical@vvce.ac.in

Think Beyond Limits. Build Beyond Boundaries. Sustain Beyond Tomorrow.

Join SUSTAINIQ 2026 and turn your ideas into innovations that shape a sustainable future!
